List the releases of an artist

Source: R/lists.R
dig_artist_releases.Rd

Lists the releases and master releases an artist appears on, with the role of the artist on each.

Usage

dig_artist_releases(
  id,
  sort = c("year", "title", "format"),
  order = c("asc", "desc"),
  all = FALSE,
  page = 1,
  per_page = 50
)

Arguments

id

An artist ID, as a number or as a code copied from 'Discogs' such as "a1" or "[a1]".

sort

The column to sort by: "year", "title" or "format".

order

The sort order: "asc" or "desc".

all

If TRUE, all pages are fetched and page and per_page are ignored.

page

The page to fetch.

per_page

The number of items per page, from 1 to 100.

Value

A tibble with one row per release or master release, or NULL invisibly if the API cannot be reached. type tells releases and master releases apart, and id is the ID of either. have and want are the numbers of users with the item in their collection or wantlist.

Details

'Discogs' returns up to 100 items per page and sometimes fewer than per_page. With all = TRUE, every page is fetched, which takes one request for each 100 items. If this takes more than a minute, a message gives the expected time.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
dig_artist_releases(1, all = TRUE)
}
